lines.text: Grant Cardone, CEO, Cardone Capital, $5B AUM Author of 8t business books, thirteen…
• Equity Fund Manager • Business Author 10X Rule • Business Scaling Consultant • Business Live Training 👇
To all the young hustlers out there, know your market and know your worth.
Comment BUSINESS and I’ll teach you more about making money in 90 minutes than I learned in 5 years getting an accounting degree… and I’ll do it for free.
I’ve seen a lot of disagreement on this, do you think marketing or sales is more important? And why?

A business owner who stops contributing to the success of the business eventually becomes the biggest liability in the business. Ownership isn’t a title…it’s responsibility. If you want the rewards, you have to stay in the fight: lead, sell, solve problems, create opportunities, and keep pushing the business forward. If you’re looking for the problem in your business, make sure you’ve also checked the mirror.
A goal without a plan is just a wish, let’s be honest. Comment PLAN to get the plan I’m following for the last quarter of 2026.

If you don’t get rid of bad apples, you’re essentially paying someone to slowly ruin your company. I’ve narrowed down the success I’ve had building my business into 7 things that cost $0 that you can start implementing immediately. Comment BUSINESS to join the free zoom call.
Scared money don’t make money. Comment SUMMIT to spend 3 days with me at the end of the month talking all things business in Fort Lauderdale

“YOU’RE SO LUCKY.” You see the picture now, you didn’t see the picture back then. You didn’t see the small rooms. You didn’t see the long days. You didn’t see the cold calls. You didn’t hear the hang-ups. You didn’t feel the rejection. You didn’t see the follow-ups I didn’t want to make. You didn’t see the thousands of flights, airports, hotel rooms, and miles traveled chasing opportunities. You didn’t see the years I spent selling before anyone knew my name. You didn’t see the content I created when hardly anyone was watching. You didn’t see the deals I lost, the doors that closed, or the people who told me NO. You see the result. You call it luck. I call it reps. I kept making the calls. I kept getting rejected. I kept creating. I kept traveling. I kept selling. I kept showing up. Over and over and over again. I didn’t wake up one day lucky. I built the life you’re looking at through years of work you never saw. Now you look at the result and say, “Man... you’re so lucky.” Maybe, but what you call luck is usually years of work nobody saw. Don’t envy the outcome. Study the process. Comment FREE to get the playbook I built through years of trial & error on building and scaling a business, and maybe you too can get “lucky.”
Why do people hate their jobs? Simple ways to Motivate People with Targets - comment targets

You don’t hate the work. You hate waking up every day doing it without knowing where it is taking you. That is not a work problem. That is a plan problem. People who know exactly where they are going and why they are doing the work never hate it. They might get tired. They might get frustrated. But they do not dread it because every day connects to something bigger than the task itself. Comment PLAN if you are willing to let me help you develop that plan you’ve been missing... Not a vague idea of what you want. A real target with a real number and a real deadline.

Yesterday was BIG. 🇺🇸 America.gov means more access, more transparency, and a government making it easier for people to get the information and services they need. A government that listens. A government that serves. A government that puts its people first. Pretty cool to witness a step toward a more connected, transparent government that truly cares about its people. This is what progress looks like. 🇺🇸 📸: @courtlynnreed

Whether you have a title or not, you are leading someone. Your kids are watching how you handle pressure. Your team is watching how you show up on the hard days. Your friends are watching what you tolerate. Your community is watching what you stand for. Leadership is not a position. It is a pattern of behavior that people around you are reading every single day whether you are aware of it or not. The question is not whether you are a leader. You already are one. The question is whether you are proud of the example you are setting.
